name: Gladly
one_liner: Customer service platform built around customer profiles and conversations, with a REST API and webhooks.
auth_notes: Token-based HTTP Basic auth: agent email as username and an API token as password, sent in the Authorization header. Tokens belong to a user holding the API User permission.
access_notes: A Gladly administrator must grant the API User permission to a user, who then creates tokens under More settings > API Tokens. Pages do not state plan requirements or cost.

buildability.rationale: Basic-auth API tokens and a documented REST API with sandbox and webhooks. Requires an administrator to grant the API User permission, and plan requirements are not stated.

identity.quote: Gladly is a customer service platform built around people, not tickets.

auth.quote: Gladly API uses token-based Basic Authentication.

access.quote: Gladly Administrators can set API permissions on an agent-by-agent basis.

sandbox.quote: Your sandbox environment is accessible at https://{organization}.gladly.qa

api_surface.quote: Clients can access the REST API via HTTPS at your organization's Gladly domain

mcp.quote: Connect your AI agent to StackOne's Gladly MCP server and give it 65 MCP tools out of the box.

buildability.quote: To create and use an API token, your user must have the API User permission.

needs_human_reason: API User permission must be granted by a Gladly administrator, and the pages do not state plan requirements or pricing for API access.
